artifact.claim_boundary: Atlas provides investigation context only. Human investigator keeps final judgment.
known_limitations: The IR is bounded to the referenced runtime window.

artifact.summary: OEM Tier2 reviewed the bounded runtime window and the matched historical RGA; the case aligns with a known LiDAR communication investigation path and was resolved after network restoration.

known_limitations: Reuse requires a bounded runtime window and linked sensor closure package.
Reuse does not replace case-specific human review.
reuse_conditions: Reuse when LiDAR heartbeat timeout and point cloud loss are present in one bounded unexpected stop window.
Reuse when the OEM historical RGA and sensor closure package are both linked.
artifact.summary: Reusable OEM-side investigation note for bounded LiDAR unexpected-stop cases matched to historical RGA.

pull_strategy: Atlas starts from Historical RGA assets before opening a fresh investigation branch.

artifact.historical_ll: Unexpected stop investigations should begin with LiDAR communication checks.
why_retrieved: Current event shows unexpected stop with LiDAR heartbeat timeout and missing point cloud.
Historical OEM RGA carries the same communication-loss pattern and provides the first investigation path.
Tier2 investigation therefore begins from Historical IR and Historical LL instead of starting from a blank sheet.
